Emanuel (Mannie) Fabian ✓ @manniefabian
Sun, 05 Jul 2026 17:26:24 UTC

A cell of Hezbollah operatives identified near Israeli troops in southern Lebanon were targeted in an airstrike earlier today, the IDF says.

The military says troops of the Commando Brigade spotted the operatives, who were riding motorcycles, in the village of al-Aaqaide, near Nabatieh and close to Israel's buffer zone.

"The terrorists' activity posed a threat to our forces," the military says, adding that they were struck "to remove the threat."

ترجمه خودکار فارسی

ارتش می‌گوید نیروهای تیپ تکاور (کماندو)، این عوامل را که سوار بر موتورسیکلت در روستای العقیده در نزدیکی نبطیه و در نزدیکی منطقه حائل اسرائیل بودند، شناسایی کردند.

ارتش با بیان اینکه این حمله برای «رفع تهدید» انجام شد، افزود: «فعالیت تروریست‌ها تهدیدی برای نیروهای ما محسوب می‌شد.»

Tehran, Iran

During the official farewell ceremony for Khamenei, religious eulogist Mehdi Rasooli:

"By your blood, Trump's assassination is our responsibility. From now on, shrouds, not garments, will adorn us. By your blood, Trump's assassination is our responsibility."

Mohammad Mokhber, advisor and aide to the Leader of the Islamic Republic, stated on the sidelines of Ali Khamenei's funeral that those responsible for Khamenei's death "will not die of natural causes," and the regime will exact revenge upon them.
